assets.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Input image 1 is the approved silhouette to simplify; input image 2 is the game's AIRCRAFT STYLE reference only. Produce a simplified 2D game sprite matching image 2: broad clean painted color areas, smooth subtle three-tone volume shading, thin outline, NO realistic material textures. Keep the tracked hull and compact rounded turret. Simplify running gear to 5 clean readable road wheels, a single continuous track band; keep cream trim on olive paint. Remove ALL tiny bolts, scratches, rust, dirt, perforations, handles, tools, extra boxes, antennae and minor trim. Most important remove BOTH LONG GUN BARRELS entirely, including muzzle brakes, leaving only the compact central gun elevation pivot/housing; barrels will be drawn and aimed by game Canvas. Keep turret sitting visibly on hull. Nearly orthographic SIDE VIEW facing LEFT, just slight view of roof, low perspective distortion. Believable proportions, NOT cute bubbles or oversized wheels. Entire object visible, centered with transparent padding. Genuine transparent background, no floor, no shadow on ground, no backdrop, no words. Large simple silhouette readable at game size 100px, clean color saturation matching aircraft. This should be MUCH less detailed than input image1, not a photographic military render.
assets.extractionPrompt: Use case: background-extraction. Keep the entire simplified anti-aircraft vehicle pixel-identical in shape, paint, volume and absence of long barrels. Remove EVERY trace of backdrop: colored glow, haze, dark vignette, floor shadow and mist. Outside the precise vehicle silhouette must be FULLY transparent alpha=0. No diffuse aura or shadow behind or below the wheels. Clean transparent cutout only. Do not add barrels. Do not change the vehicle.
